behavior.arguments: rdi = struct base; qwords are read at [rdi+8] (cursor) and [rdi+0x18] (end). rsi = input. No other argument is read.

branch_targets.cmovb: taken = input when input < scaled (unsigned), else scaled; the branch is a conditional move, not a jump, so control flow is linear.

edges.input_below_scaled: when input < scaled, the whole input advances the cursor and the remainder is 0; e.g. input 10, count 5 gives taken 10, new cursor 0x370, remainder 0.
edges.input_dominates: when input exceeds scaled, only scaled advances the cursor and the remainder is input - scaled; e.g. input 2^64-1, count 1 gives taken 0x2e8ba2e8ba2e8ba3, remainder 0xd1745d1745d1745c.
edges.scaled_unit: count 11 scales to exactly 1 (low 64 bits), so input 100 with span 88 advances the cursor by only 88 and returns 99.
edges.zero: when input, cursor, and end are all 0, count, scaled, taken, and remainder are all 0 and the cursor is unchanged.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with mov %rsi,%rax (NOT endbr64); one conditional move (cmovb), zero calls, zero jumps; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: Let count = ([rdi+0x18] - [rdi+8]) >> 3 (logical shift, wrapping subtract); scaled = count * 0x2e8ba2e8ba2e8ba3 (low 64 bits); taken = min(input, scaled) unsigned; [rdi+8] += taken * 88 (wrapping); return input - taken (wrapping). No other field is written.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Exactly one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
